title: Action Sport Fishing

services.name: Six Hour Charter
services.desc: Action Sportfishing is a 35-foot Cabo vessel, owned and operated by one of Maui’s most seasoned fishing captains. Departing from Ma‘alaea Harbor, she offers a great balance of comfort and performance. Onboard, you’ll find a spacious bridge, ample seating in the cabin, and a clean, modern restroom. Outfitted with outriggers, GPS, sonar, and a variety of rods and reels-from light tackle (25s) to heavy-duty gear (80s)-Action is ready for any fishing challenge. The boat accommodates up to six passengers, with regular departures between 5:30 and 6:00 a.m., every day of the week.
